title: The Effect of Agomelatine or Fluoxentine on Heart Rate Variability in Patients With Major Depressive Disorder
brief_summary: Phase advance of HRV will be anticipated in agomelatine group. It is anticipated that both agomelatine and floxentine will increase HRV at the end of the treatment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Asian patients
* Male or female
* 18 to 65 years outpatients
* DSM-IV-TR criteria for Major Depressive Disorder

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with cardiac conditions and other physical conditions contraindicated for drug study
* Shift worker
* Patients known to be non-responders to fluoxetine treatment
* Pregnancy, or breastfeeding
